hint: ผมมั่นใจว่า EKG นี้เป็น STEMI เฉียบพลัน

parsed.rationale: V1–V4 show QS complexes with convex ST elevation of about 4–6 mm in V2–V4, which meets STEMI criteria; some late T-wave dipping and the established QS waves mean an older infarct with an LV aneurysm should be ruled out against old ECGs and the clinical picture.
